EXT.evidence: Leads the group through the meal, announcing the first course and updating everyone on the next course timing—behavior consistent with an outgoing host.

AGR.evidence: Responds warmly to praise (“very glad” the guest liked the dish) and communicates clearly and politely about what’s next.

CON.evidence: Runs a structured multi-course meal and gives precise timing (“about eight and a half minutes”) for the next course; clearly manages portions.
